name: Holder binding (key from secret)

request.need: PR-HLD / ADR-001 S4: the presenter is the subject, not a party holding a copy

dish: A verifier learns that the presenting key is derived from the same secret the credentials were issued to, without learning the secret or any long-term key.

method.clause: pk_presentation = PRF(secret, context) and the credential commitment opens to the same secret

doesNotEstablish: absence of coercion or account sharing
compatibility with non-exportable keys or arbitrary credential key formats; the selected profile must bind the actual authenticated holder key to the available witness

substitutions.route: L_PRF Schnorr proof of PRF-key ownership (paper §9.1)

issuance: issuer binds the credential to a commitment to the holder secret (pk_U ‖ com_att signed — paper §2.4)

history.evidence: zkp-tf #18 (talltree 08-26 / Scott 08-27): seed set for the board
